Name: MH Chest Stasher
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Chest Stasher [/center][/b][/size][size=2]Adds a simple "Send All" button to chest menus that transfers all items from your inventory to the chest in one click. The perfect companion to Chest Grabber!
[/size]
[b][size=3]Features[/size][/b]
- Configurable keybind
- Respects locked/favorited slots from Convenient Inventory
- Manual slot locking option when Convenient Inventory is not installed
- Sends as many items as possible if chest is full
- Works with all chest types
- Button can be hidden via config if you only want the keybind

Just a simple quality of life improvement for when you need to fill chests quickly.

[size=3][b]Notes [/b][/size][list]
[*]The description has been translated from Spanish.
[/list]
